title: Weakly inhomogeneous solutions to a nonlinear Vlasov--Fokker--Planck equation in a domain
summary: A nonlinear Vlasov--Fokker--Planck equation is considered in a bounded domain, with specular reflection imposed on the boundary. It is proven that if the initial datum is sufficiently close, in a weighted $L^\infty$-space, to a radial and spatially homogeneous function that is regular enough, then a corresponding global-in-time weak solution exists, and this one decays with exponential rate to the global Maxwellian.
